reviews.body: Thanks for the fix! I have some minor comment, otherwise looks good!

review_comments.body: The current test infrastructure is implemented in `vue-cli/e2e` directory. Please, move this test there. I know that most of the times our GUI tests are failing, but it is on our TODO list to fix them. Thank you!

comments.body:
Thanks, moved: the jest test is removed and the check now lives in `vue-cli/e2e/specs/reviewStatusRule.js` (the "add new review status rule" test asserts the select menu of the rule dialog does not offer "Unreviewed"). Since "Unreviewed" is no longer in that menu, the item indexes picked in the "add new review status rule" and "remove all filtered review status rules" specs are shifted by one so they still select "False positive". I also dropped the jest `modulePaths` setting that only the old test needed. The nightwatch suite was not run locally (no browser/server environment), and it is not enabled in CI, so this spec is unexecuted so far.

This reply was prepared with Claude Code (AI-assisted).
